issues.where: the shake from frame 0 to frame 353
issues.what: it reads as one action, winter at rest, a lift, a storm, and a landing in spring that feels like a reward. No later season arrives, and winter never returns, so the ending is a new season rather than a close of the cycle
issues.fix: keep this same globe, shake on through summer and autumn, and set it back down in winter so the return is an ending and not a cut to the opening frame
